description: DentaFlow product knowledge for Interactive Demo mode

documents.title: What is DentaFlow?
documents.content: DentaFlow is an AI-powered dental clinic management system with 4 specialized AI agents that work 24/7. Unlike chatbots, DentaFlow is a multi-agent system where each AI has specific expertise: Alex (Reception), Sarah (Clinical), Marcus (Finance), and Sophia (Operations). It integrates with Odoo ERP for real-time clinic data and supports multi-channel communication (Web, SMS, Email, WhatsApp, Telegram).

documents.title: Why DentaFlow is NOT a Chatbot
documents.content: DentaFlow is NOT a chatbot. Here's why: 1) Multi-Agent System - 4 specialized AIs vs. one generic bot. 2) Context-Aware - Connected to Odoo ERP with real patient data, not scripted responses. 3) Adaptive Learning - Improves from each interaction, doesn't repeat same answers. 4) Natural Conversation - No scripts, understands context and nuance. 5) Action-Oriented - Actually schedules appointments, processes payments, updates records - not just answers questions.

documents.title: The 4 AI Agents
documents.content: DentaFlow has 4 specialized AI agents: 1) Alex - Reception & Patient Relations: Schedules appointments, answers questions, handles billing inquiries, sends reminders. 2) Sarah - Clinical Assistant: Manages treatment records, dental charts, prescriptions, medical history. 3) Marcus - CFO: Financial analysis, revenue tracking, payment status, profitability insights. 4) Sophia - Admin: Operations management, scheduling optimization, staff coordination, efficiency analysis.

documents.title: Multi-Channel Communication
documents.content: DentaFlow supports multi-channel communication: Currently Available: Web Chat (instant), SMS (fast delivery), Email (detailed info). Coming Q1 2026: WhatsApp Business API, Telegram Bot. Benefits: 3x higher response rates, patients choose their preferred channel, lower cost than phone calls, automated reminders across all channels.

documents.title: Odoo ERP Integration
documents.content: DentaFlow integrates seamlessly with Odoo ERP: Real-time patient data sync, appointment calendar integration, billing and invoicing connection, treatment records access, inventory management link. Setup takes about 1 hour with our team's help. All patient information stays in Odoo - DentaFlow just reads and updates it in real-time.

documents.title: Pricing Plans
documents.content: DentaFlow Pricing: Starter Plan: ₪799/month - Up to 500 patients, 2 AI agents (Alex + Sarah), Web Chat + SMS. Professional Plan: ₪1,299/month - Up to 2,000 patients, 4 AI agents (all), All channels (Web, SMS, Email, WhatsApp, Telegram), Priority support. Enterprise Plan: Custom pricing - Unlimited patients, Custom AI agents, White-label option, Dedicated success manager. Pilot Program (Limited to 10 clinics): 6 months FREE + 20% off forever!

documents.title: Implementation Process
documents.content: Getting started with DentaFlow: Week 1: Odoo integration setup (1 hour), Import existing patient data, Configure AI agents. Week 2: Team training (2 hours), Test with sample patients, Customize responses. Week 3: Soft launch with select patients, Monitor and adjust, Full rollout. Average time to full deployment: 2-3 weeks. Our team handles 90% of the setup!

documents.title: Time Savings & ROI
documents.content: DentaFlow saves clinics 10+ hours per week: Automated appointment scheduling (3 hours/week), Automated patient reminders (2 hours/week), Automated billing inquiries (2 hours/week), Automated follow-ups (1 hour/week), Reduced no-shows with smart reminders (2 hours/week). ROI: Average clinic saves ₪8,000/month in staff time. Break-even in first month. Typical payback: 3-4 weeks.

documents.title: Security & Compliance
documents.content: DentaFlow is fully compliant: HIPAA Compliant - All patient data encrypted, GDPR Compliant - EU data protection standards, Israeli Privacy Law - Local regulations met, SOC 2 Type II - Security audited. Data Storage: Patient data stays in your Odoo instance, AI conversations encrypted in transit and at rest, No data shared with third parties, Regular security audits.

documents.title: Free Trial & Pilot Program
documents.content: Try DentaFlow risk-free: Free Trial (30 days): No credit card required, Full feature access, Setup your own clinic, Cancel anytime. Pilot Program (10 clinics only): 6 months completely FREE, 20% discount for life after pilot, White-glove onboarding, Direct access to product team, Influence product roadmap. Requirements: 2-5 dentists, Weekly feedback sessions, Willing to be a case study (optional).

documents.title: Customer Support
documents.content: DentaFlow provides comprehensive support: Starter Plan: Email support (24-hour response), Knowledge base access, Community forum. Professional Plan: Priority email support (4-hour response), Phone support (business hours), Monthly check-ins. Enterprise Plan: Dedicated success manager, 24/7 phone support, Custom SLAs, On-site training available. All plans include: Setup assistance, Training materials, Regular product updates.

documents.title: Languages Supported
documents.content: DentaFlow is multilingual: Fully supported: Hebrew (עברית), English, Arabic (العربية). AI agents seamlessly switch between languages based on patient preference. All interfaces available in Hebrew and English. Coming soon: Russian, French, Spanish.
